Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body: Is the Succubu's agg dmg considered hand damage? (in case of Lucky Blow etc)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
>
> Is the Succubu's agg dmg considered hand damage? (in case of Lucky Blow etc)

Other way around: Succubus's hand damage is "considered" aggravated.
She has 1 strength => does 1 damage with a defualt hand strike (or 2
damage with a Lucky Blow hand strike). The damage from her hand strike
(modified or not) is aggravated.
